item.title: Indiana National Guard moves closer to expanded policing powers through new legislation
item.description: A bill advancing at the Statehouse would allow Indiana National Guard military police to make arrests and conduct searches when activated by the governor.

item.title: Bill to allow firing squads to carry out death sentences fails House vote
item.description: Lawmakers voted against a bill to allow death sentences to be carried out by firing squads. Many lawmakers indicated they opposed death sentences altogether.

item.title: Martin University's closure brings founder Boniface Hardin's vision for equity to an end
item.description: Last December, Martin University, Indiana’s only predominantly Black college, announced it would close. The school was founded by the late activist and Catholic priest Boniface Hardin, with a mission to serve students historically excluded from higher education.

item.title: Hoosier medical debt tops $2 billion. A bill offering some relief just passed the Senate
item.description: Hoosier medical debt tops $2 billion. A bill offering relief to debtors just passed the Senate and sponsors say it could deliver relief to over a million residents

item.title: Vigil remembers lives lost during immigration enforcement
item.description: The vigil, organized by the Marion County Young Democrats, was for people who have died or disappeared during immigration enforcement.

item.title: A guide to your rights at Indiana protests, in the streets, and at school
item.description: As communities throughout the country organize against immigration enforcement, here’s what to know about protesting in Indiana.

item.title: Indy residents gather for food, fellowship, and support for their immigrant neighbors
item.description: People congregated at Northview Church of the Brethren for food, music and fellowship to learn how they can support their immigrant neighbors. The gathering focused on what to do next.

item.title: Veteran Indiana House member leaving Trump’s Republican Party
item.description: Trump-endorsed challenger enters race against senator who opposed redistricting demand.

item.title: Hundreds of Indiana students walk out of schools to protest ICE
item.description: Students at urban and suburban Indianapolis high schools walked out of class Monday to protest federal immigration enforcement.

item.title: Start your engines: Trump greenlights IndyCar race around D.C. monuments
item.description: The nation’s capital will host an autorace through its streets this summer, President Donald Trump said Friday.
